decisions.choice: The two-line AI-transcript.py session header/title is optional outer metadata and is excluded from the base canonical transcript body.
Timestamps and record numbers remain optional; stable turn_id is added as another optional heading annotation. The base golden has optional heading metadata disabled.
Use AI-transcript.py code-language inference; the fixture's declared unknown container.exec command renders with a bash fence.
Use AI-transcript.py EOF formatting, including its final blank line.
Use DownloadConversation citation rendering, including the memory-file favicon behaviour exercised by this fixture.

Both compared renderers agreed for this fixture: preserve source part position and distinguish linked image-not-available from image-missing. Authenticated image-resource resolution is a separate host capability and is not fabricated in this golden.

Tool calls/results occurring in a ChatGPT commentary sequence stay in that ChatGPT Commentary section; a later true final Assistant message remains a separate ChatGPT section. Arbitrary tool payload Markdown is contained with adaptive fences rather than repaired.
decisions.authority: live DownloadConversation v0.6.142 export evidence and user-approved fix 2026-08-29
